user.title: Codex
user.description: Codex automatically detects the installed Codex CLI Worker app and its generated worker API token.

reauth_confirm.title: Codex
reauth_confirm.description: Reconnect to the installed Codex CLI Worker app.

reconfigure.title: Codex
reconfigure.description: Reconnect to the installed Codex CLI Worker app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not discover or connect to the Codex CLI Worker app. Make sure it is installed, started, and has generated its worker API token.
error.invalid_auth: The worker rejected its generated API token. Restart the Codex CLI Worker app and try again.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not discover or connect to the Codex CLI Worker app.
abort.unknown: The Codex config entry could not be found.

remote_control_config_change.title: Review a change made while remote control was on
remote_control_config_change.description: {count} change(s) to your configuration since remote control from the ChatGPT app was turned on add actions that Codex may not add on its own. The first is {what} in {where}: `{text}`. Review it before you reload or restart Home Assistant. Then open the Codex app page, Settings, Remote control, and choose Mark reviewed.

codex_not_signed_in.title: Codex is not signed in
codex_not_signed_in.description: The Codex worker is reachable, but it is not signed in to ChatGPT, or its sign-in has expired or been revoked. Open the Codex panel in the sidebar and press Sign in: the page shows a code and a QR code for the ChatGPT sign-in page. You can also start the sign-in with the `codex_cli.start_login` action. This repair clears itself once the sign-in works.

continue_task.name: Continue task
continue_task.description: Send a new message to a saved Codex conversation.

reply_task.name: Reply to task
reply_task.description: Answer the question of a Codex task that is waiting for input.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task that is waiting for input.

reply.name: Reply
reply.description: Your answer. To pick one of the choices Codex offered, send that choice's text.

turn_id.name: Turn ID
turn_id.description: The turn that asked the question, from `turn_id` in the `codex_cli_task_result` event. When set, the reply is refused once that question is no longer the one waiting.

list_tasks.name: List tasks
list_tasks.description: Get all tasks or a filtered page of saved conversations.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (1–500). Omit to return all tasks.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Number of matching tasks to skip.

status.name: Status
status.description: Only return tasks with this status.

order.name: Order
order.description: Order by creation time (oldest first) or latest activity (newest first).

summary.name: Compact summaries
summary.description: Return short entries instead of full task records.
